title: Vice President: Rebalance Investment Under a New Constraint
prompt: You oversee a $12 million annual change portfolio. Half is already spent; $6m remains. A revised forecast reduces the remaining allowance to $4.5m. Teams propose cutting every remaining project by 25%. The four remaining commitments are $2m platform renewal, $1.5m service expansion, $1m quality recovery and $1.5m internal automation. Discuss your recommendation with the finance partner (the AI).

rubric.label: Separate cost categories
rubric.description: Uses remaining controllable costs rather than headline totals.

anchors.0: Treats spent money as available or assumes all remaining costs scale linearly.
anchors.2: Identifies the $1.5m reduction and asks about commitments.
anchors.4: Separates sunk, committed, pause and avoidable costs; reconciles an affordable remaining plan while stating where a partial allocation may fail to deliver value.

rubric.label: Prioritize organizational outcomes
rubric.description: Uses evidence and consequences across divisions.

anchors.2: Compares impact and urgency across projects.
anchors.4: Compares customer obligations, quality risk, uncertainty and option value with consistent criteria; explains specific retained/deferred outcomes and tests sensitivity to the assumptions.

anchors.0: Delegates the entire decision to arithmetic or hides tradeoffs from the board.
anchors.2: Consults owners and communicates the allocation.
anchors.4: Obtains viable options from accountable owners, verifies costs with finance, records the authorized decision and establishes a review trigger if benefits, risk or commitments change.

reference.scenario: You oversee a $12 million annual change portfolio. Half is already spent; $6m remains. A revised forecast reduces the remaining allowance to $4.5m. Teams propose cutting every remaining project by 25%. The four remaining commitments are $2m platform renewal, $1.5m service expansion, $1m quality recovery and $1.5m internal automation. Discuss your recommendation with the finance partner (the AI).

facts.value: Platform renewal has a $0.7m non-cancellable supplier commitment; service expansion can pause after a $0.3m customer handoff. Quality recovery addresses a documented recurring defect; automation benefits have not yet been demonstrated in a pilot.
facts.reveal_when: candidate asks about sunk costs, commitments or evidence

facts.value: The board approved the reduced allowance but has not chosen projects. The finance partner can help verify costs; project owners must validate the effect of partial funding.
facts.reveal_when: candidate asks about governance or reliability of cost assumptions

model_points: Separates sunk, committed, pause and avoidable costs; reconciles an affordable remaining plan while stating where a partial allocation may fail to deliver value.
Compares customer obligations, quality risk, uncertainty and option value with consistent criteria; explains specific retained/deferred outcomes and tests sensitivity to the assumptions.
Obtains viable options from accountable owners, verifies costs with finance, records the authorized decision and establishes a review trigger if benefits, risk or commitments change.

probes.question: Which project might become unviable at 75% funding?

probes.trigger: candidate cancels platform renewal for $2m savings
probes.question: Which portion is actually avoidable?
How will that change be reflected in the authorized portfolio?

fair_alternatives: Multiple allocations are acceptable; no preferred project is an answer key.
Renegotiation is an option to investigate, not an assumed release from a non-cancellable commitment.
reference.assessment_limits: Assess only the decisions and reasoning demonstrated in this fictional exercise. No hiring-readiness, personality, legal compliance or workplace performance claim follows from this score. A valid alternative can earn full credit. Unrevealed conditional facts must not be assumed known or required for credit; credit asking for needed information and a conditional plan.

interviewer_notes: You are the counterpart named in the prompt. If this is a written review, remain the hiring interviewer while the candidate reads and writes. Let the candidate finish, including thinking and self-correction. Answer only supplied facts when their reveal condition is met; otherwise say the information is unknown. Use neutral probes after a completed answer, one at a time. Do not prescribe the rubric as a spoken checklist. Accept relevant examples from work, education and community leadership. Do not request private employee records, infer protected traits, invent employment rules or promise a real organizational outcome. Simulation gives no answer before assessment; coaching may offer labeled assistance.

learning_drills.title: Reconcile a portfolio choice
learning_drills.prompt: Write an allocation totaling at most $4.5m, distinguishing commitments, change costs and deferred outcomes. This is self-guided practice with no automated assessment.
